fixture.shape: roughly balanced tree of aibt.core.memory-sequence internal nodes over aibt.test.success leaves, branching factor 8
fixture.note: A tree has exactly nodeCount - 1 edges by construction; this is not a general graph.

headlessEditMode.description: Tests/Editor/Performance/LargeGraphPerformanceTests.cs, one EditMode process, no visible window; render/reRender use BehaviorTreeGraphView.Populate in-process.

liveInteractiveEditor.description: Unity MCP execute_code against the running, focused-capable 6000.5.8f1 Editor: BehaviorTreePreviewWindow.ShowWindow() + LoadDocument() on the 2000-node fixture, a real window/UI Toolkit panel (not headless).
liveInteractiveEditor.note: loadDocumentMs covers ReferencePreviewDriver.TryCreate (compile) plus BehaviorTreePreviewWindow.Refresh (Populate + per-node breakpoint-menu manipulator attachment + status/blackboard refresh) inside a real visible window -- roughly 2.7x the headless renderMs alone (755.6ms) at the same 2000-node scale, showing real window/UI Toolkit cost the headless test cannot capture.

limitations: One measured run per scale/mode on one machine; values are not stable baselines.
GC.GetTotalMemory delta is coarse and does not prove zero allocation or locate allocations.
The live interactive number is a single warm run in one session; JIT/Roslyn warm-up in that same session was excluded by discarding the first (23.8s, dominated by ad hoc script compilation) attempt.

reRenderAfterEditMs at 2000 nodes (1276.9ms) exceeds renderMs at the same scale (755.6ms); BehaviorTreeGraphView.Populate tears down the existing view (DeleteElements) before rebuilding, so a re-render after an edit is not simply 'render again' at scale -- teardown cost is included and not separated here.
No result is generalized beyond this workstation, this Unity version, and this synthetic fixture shape.

This pilot records measurements only; it defines no performance default, threshold, or supported-graph-size claim -- see Planning~/Evidence/P3-012/README.md for this card's own usability read of these numbers, and Documentation~/benchmarks.md for why regression thresholds are Phase 4's ownership.
